//: Compiler options for `courseware/utils/build.*`. These mirror validations/tsconfig.typecheck.json so a project that builds here also passes the harness; the ONLY differences are that this one emits (no `noEmit`) and carries no `include`, because the build scripts compile one file per tsc invocation and pass the path on the command line. Compiling one standalone script at a time is deliberate: the TS teaching files have no imports/exports, so putting several in one program would make them share a global scope and collide on duplicate identifiers.
